races.display_title: Ballylinch Stud Irish EBF Ingabelle Stakes (Fillies' Listed)
races.verdict: TIMELESS TALE possibly didn't beat much on her debut at Naas but was still most impressive and, with the performance supported by a strong timefigure, she looks capable of taking the rise in grade in her stride on the way to even better things. Maire Rua is bred to be smart and remains one to be positive about having not been seen to best effect on her first try at listed level at Cork. Ibelieveicanfly is much respected back down in grade, too. TIMELESS TALE (IRE) MAIRE RUA IBELIEVEICANFLY (USA)

races.display_title: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Sovereign Path Handicap (Premier Handicap)
races.verdict: VAFORTINO has shaped better than the bare result in valuable handicaps at Royal Ascot and Galway the last twice, looking unlucky not to win latterly. Well treated on past form, he can end his losing run granted better luck. Gleneagle Bay , also better than the result at Galway, rates the main danger from 3 lb lower, with Collecting Coin and Fort Vega also respected. Any market support for last year’s winner Rahmi would be well worth noting. VAFORTINO (IRE) GLENEAGLE BAY (IRE) COLLECTING COIN

races.verdict: Having done well to land the Juddmonte International at York last month, ITEM is fancied to confirm the form with the potential for even better still to come. ITEM CONSTITUTION RIVER (FR) ALMAQAM

races.verdict: As anticipated for the prize money on offer this looks fiendishly competitive. Preference is for THRIFTY OF DIGBY , who has run her race more often than not this year, and Jessica Harrington's mare couldn't have gone much closer to adding to her tally here last time. Suzie Songs heads up the dangers arriving on a hat-trick for her handicap debut, with Rebel Wave , Bella Colombia and Aviatrice just a handful of others worth considering, too. THRIFTY OF DIGBY (IRE) SUZIE SONGS (IRE) REBEL WAVE (IRE)

races.verdict: DESERT CASTLE created a most favourable impression when making an impressive winning start to his career at Newmarket last month and, open to oodles of improvement, he's fancied to overcome the rise in grade and keep his unbeaten record intact. Gentle Hurricane ran a cracker in the Acomb considering his inexperience and appeals as the type to go on progressing, while promising Ballydoyle colt Sergei Diaghilev is another serious contender commanding plenty of respect. DESERT CASTLE GENTLE HURRICANE (IRE) SERGEI DIAGHILEV (IRE)
